blurb: Guests take helicopter tours ranging from 2 minutes to longer scenic flights over Branson landmarks such as the 76 Strip, Table Rock Lake and Dam, Silver Dollar City, and the Ozark Hills. Tours offer aerial views with engaging pilots who point out landmarks. The Deluxe tour features expansive cabin windows for photography and video.
